arm_rule_changes_vs_96: J step-pair frequencies (alpha_T, Delta_D, OL weights) pool this run's J traces over the scheduled cells, which are the mixed cells only; the OL draw uses one PCG64(7202) stream in the frozen order (inventory, level, seed)

arms.C-F-1: continuous checkpoint, fixed pair (1, continuous) at every step
arms.C-F-15: continuous checkpoint, fixed pair (15, continuous) at every step
arms.C-F-5: continuous checkpoint, fixed pair (5, continuous) at every step
arms.C-J: continuous checkpoint, joint argmax over its three MatchedController logits (horizon-only, complete control set) = #92 continuous-adaptive-e225
arms.D: hybrid checkpoint, description-only: Delta fixed at Delta_D, alpha = argmax_alpha L[Delta_D, alpha]; Delta_D = the modal Delta of J's pooled per-seed step-pair frequencies (outcome-free; 225 is divisible by every Delta so Delta_D is always feasible)
arms.F-1-continuous: hybrid checkpoint, fixed pair (1, continuous) at every step
arms.F-1-macro: hybrid checkpoint, fixed pair (1, macro) at every step
arms.F-1-micro: hybrid checkpoint, fixed pair (1, micro) at every step
arms.F-15-continuous: hybrid checkpoint, fixed pair (15, continuous) at every step
arms.F-15-macro: hybrid checkpoint, fixed pair (15, macro) at every step
arms.F-15-micro: hybrid checkpoint, fixed pair (15, micro) at every step
arms.F-5-continuous: hybrid checkpoint, fixed pair (5, continuous) at every step
arms.F-5-macro: hybrid checkpoint, fixed pair (5, macro) at every step
arms.F-5-micro: hybrid checkpoint, fixed pair (5, micro) at every step
arms.J: hybrid checkpoint, joint argmax over the nine MatchedController logits at every step (logits with Delta > remaining masked to -inf inside the controller; argmax ties to the lower PAIRS index) = #92 hybrid-adaptive-e225
arms.M: hybrid checkpoint, factorized selector from the same logits, no training: Delta* = argmax_Delta logsumexp_alpha L[Delta, alpha], alpha* = argmax_alpha logsumexp_Delta L[Delta, alpha]; pair (Delta*, alpha*)
arms.OL: hybrid checkpoint, open-loop: pairs drawn i.i.d. from J's pooled per-seed step-pair frequencies renormalized over the pairs feasible at the remaining horizon (uniform over feasible pairs if their pooled mass is zero); one draw sequence per cell shared by every candidate; one PCG64(7202) stream consumed in the frozen cell order (inventory, member, seed)
arms.T: hybrid checkpoint, temporal-only: alpha fixed at alpha_T, Delta = argmax_Delta L[Delta, alpha_T]; alpha_T = the modal alpha of J's pooled per-seed step-pair frequencies (outcome-free)

claim_boundary: decision-only rollouts of the frozen ICLR #77 N1 checkpoints and controllers from the #105 F77 anchors of the sealed #109 evaluation levels to endpoint 225 on the Gate-B mixed cells; inventories never pooled; every interval DESCRIPTIVE; zero engine seconds; no training

guards.G1: smoke: at least one #96 record with >= 2 distinct costs reproduces exactly on its original cell (bit-equal costs, chosen ordinal, ranking order, steps, schedules, calls, MACs; census over all 3186 #96 records reported), and the #96 G1 criterion (chosen ordinal equal, selected cost within 1e-3) holds on the #96 G1 J and F-15-continuous cells
guards.G2: anchor store hash equals the pinned #105 hash, parsed under SCORING_POLICY, covers every scored level, and the smoke re-parse is bit-identical
guards.G3: verdict resolution 1.0 on admissible candidates of mixed grid cells; nonfinite share <= 0.1
guards.G4: <= 0.2 of mixed grid cells have J or F* fully tied
guards.G5: J non-modal step share >= 0.1 on mixed grid cells AND Kendall tau-b(J, F(modal)) < 1 on >= 0.25 of them
guards.caps: summed worker GPU seconds <= 21600.0, elapsed scoring wall <= 21600.0 s

launch: phase 1 (F x9, J, M, C-F x3, C-J) on 4 GPUs once; --frequencies once; phase 2 (T, D, OL) once
role: #104 work item 3: the #96 contrast set re-run on the sealed #109 evaluation split, scored once

rules.g6: G6 (#104 reading): primary interval half-width <= delta = 0.02; reported per inventory for J - F* and per contrast; the #96 plan's literal G6 bound 0.05 and the #104 design delta (grid 0.02, union inventories 0.05) are reported alongside; where G6 fails the achieved half-width is stated with the mixed-level count m and m x (half-width / delta)^2
rules.guard_failure: any failed guard turns every token of that cost into readiness_or_precision_insufficient
rules.primary: theta_grid = AUC_J - AUC_F* over the mixed grid cells (tie-free cost); supported iff all guards pass AND mean >= 0.02 AND lower bound > 0; not_supported_by_this_experiment iff all guards pass AND upper bound < 0.02; otherwise readiness_or_precision_insufficient
rules.primary_cost: tie_free (#111 PRIMARY_COST, pre-declared); the #96 count cost is secondary, scored from the same endpoints and reported in full with its own guards
rules.replication: J - F* on offset / angle / power reported verbatim with the count meeting mean >= delta AND lower > 0 (the #96 rule, DESCRIPTIVE); not interpretable if any guard fails
rules.secondary_reading: the #112 Gate-B predictor's #96-style contrasts published by #101 (compute.json), re-tabulated with half-widths and the G6 reading; not re-scored
rules.secondary_tokens: J - M and J - OL on the grid: the same rule with guards G1-G5, G7 and caps and the contrast's own half-width <= 0.02 in place of G6 (the #96 rule)
rules.selection: F* (cross-fit r-dagger) = the fixed pair with the highest mean, over the other three inventories, of the member-mean AUC; F_hindsight = in-inventory best fixed pair; C-F* likewise over C-F; ties by arm order; selected per cost from that cost's AUCs (#96 rules)

stack.anchors: #105 F77 store: the #71 repaired-adapter batch-1 parse of each evaluation level's decision frame (shot frame 0 of its first complete candidate, the Gate-B rule), parsed under deterministic_scoring()
stack.controller: #77 N1 MatchedController per seed and family (the #96 controllers)

costs.count: frozen TaskObjective: 1000 * clamp(pig presence, 0, 1) + sum over block slots of clamp(block presence, 0, 1)
costs.tie_free: pig presence (unclamped) - 0.1 * Euclidean displacement of the pig slot center (normalized screen units) between the start carrier and the endpoint carrier; lower is better

stack.predictor: #77 N1 hybrid / continuous checkpoints bound by the #87 plan (the #96 stack)

statistics.cell_auc: t96.cell_view (P(success cost < failure cost), ties 0.5, admissible candidates)
statistics.interval: t96.contrast: paired per (level, seed); level-clustered percentile bootstrap of member means, 10000 draws, PCG64 7201, [0.025, 0.975], DESCRIPTIVE
